Confirm permanent deletion

This removes conversations from your ChatGPT account; it does not archive them. You cannot restore deleted chats. OpenAI schedules them for permanent deletion within 30 days, subject to its retention exceptions. For “Export, then delete,” only conversations whose export succeeds will be deleted.
